ACADEMIC CONNECTIONS, CULTURAL EXCHANGE, AND EXPANDING INTERNATIONAL COOPERATION BETWEEN DONG NAI TECHNOLOGY UNIVERSITY AND TELKOM UNIVERSITY
From September 27 to October 3, 2026, Dong Nai Technology University (DNTU) will welcome a delegation of students, lecturers, and staff from Telkom University (Indonesia) to participate in the DNTU – Telkom University Academic and Cultural Exchange Program.
The program is organized by the Faculty of Communication and Design in collaboration with the DNTU International Cooperation Department, aiming to create opportunities for students and lecturers from both universities to learn, connect, and experience an international educational environment together. The program also contributes to strengthening academic connections, promoting cultural exchange, and advancing the internationalization of education and training activities at DNTU.
Academic Connections and Cultural Experiences
As part of the program, the Telkom University delegation will participate in a range of academic, cultural exchange, and experiential activities with DNTU students and lecturers.
From an academic perspective, the delegation will join professional classes with students from the Faculty of Communication and Design, as well as attend the seminar “Digital Communication: Strategy, Culture, and Impact.” The seminar will provide a platform for lecturers and students from both universities to share and exchange perspectives on topics related to digital communication.
The Academic and Cultural Exchange Program between Dong Nai Technology University and Telkom University, Indonesia.
In addition, activities introducing Vietnamese culture and language, interactions with DNTU student clubs, hands-on event organization activities, and opportunities to learn about the cultural significance of the Mid-Autumn Festival will offer diverse experiences, giving students from both universities more opportunities to connect and learn about each other's cultures.
The program will not be limited to the university campus. It will also include a visit to Ho Chi Minh City, allowing the Telkom University delegation to explore distinctive aspects of Vietnam's culture, history, and urban life.
Expanding Professional Exchange between Lecturers of the Two Universities
In particular, as part of the program, two lecturers from Telkom University will participate in academic exchange activities with DNTU lecturers and students on October 1–2, 2026.
The activity will provide an opportunity for lecturers from both universities to share their professional expertise, teaching experience, and perspectives in the field of education and training. Through this exchange, DNTU and Telkom University will have further opportunities to expand their connections and explore potential academic collaboration in the future.
Dr. Huynh Thanh Trang – Dean of the Faculty of Communication and Design (right), Dong Nai Technology University – during an exchange with representatives of Telkom University, Indonesia.
Strengthening International Connections and Creating More Learning Experiences
Through the Academic and Cultural Exchange Program, DNTU and Telkom University continue to create opportunities for students to learn from one another, for lecturers to share their expertise, and for both universities to expand academic and cultural exchange.
Students from Dong Nai Technology University and Telkom University, Indonesia, pose for a commemorative photo with meaningful gifts.
For students, learning and interacting with international peers not only provides valuable experiences in a multicultural environment but also broadens their opportunities to gain new perspectives in their studies and professional fields. For the University, this is one of the activities contributing to the internationalization of education and training, strengthening connections with international partners, and expanding an internationally integrated learning environment for students.
Students from DNTU and Telkom University, Indonesia, pose for a commemorative photo.
The DNTU – Telkom University program also serves as an opportunity for the two universities to continue building connections grounded in academic exchange, cultural engagement, and shared experiences, laying the foundation for future exchange and collaboration activities.
Dong Nai Technology University warmly welcomes the Telkom University delegation to DNTU!
We wish the Telkom University delegation meaningful experiences, memorable connections, and an enriching academic and cultural exchange journey at DNTU.
